title: a proof that patches a name the judge it asks reads in another process is reported, naming the patched target
intention: proof_coverage reports a proof that patches a module attribute in its own process while a judge it asks (directly, through an ask alias, through a transitions function that reaches the wire, or through one proof-local helper) runs in another process and reads that attribute: the report names the proof, the patched target, the judge and the reach chain; a target it cannot resolve is listed, never dropped.
why: Measured 2026-11-14, three cases of one class: judges answer in CodeMother's process since 17d570c10390, so a patch made in the asker never reaches the judge. corrosion's tooth 2 (citation.ruling_covers_path, 149b), 3e08102ef35a's _TICKETS patches in test_transitions, test_entry_gate_jurisdiction and test_the_stones_are_pushed, and d3248e7cb2fd's crossings.ROOTS patch each went red long after the move and were found by hand. akiendell's scan over main plus the import_sieve fix flags 11 files / 91 findings, six of them new.
traces_to: Law 4 (a defect class found three times by hand needs an instrument); Law 3 (the report shows the patch is answer-side rather than assuming it); Law 8 (a peer leans on a green a patched asker manufactures).
how: A new module unseen_patches.py in proof_coverage: unseen_patches(source, repo_root) walks a proof's ast for patch sites live across an ask-capable call, resolves the target through the proof's imports, and reports it only when import_sieve.reaches of the judge's module holds a file that reads the attribute; unseen_patch_proofs(repo_root) runs it over every proof. Exported from proof_coverage/__init__.py; not wired into lacks().

clauses.claim: a scratch proof in each of five positive spellings (with-patch, assignment, patch.object, an ask alias, a proof-local helper) is reported by unseen_patches, naming the patched target, the judge and the reach chain

seven asker-side negatives are silent (a module the judge does not reach, no ask in scope, an attribute no reached file reads, patch.dict(os.environ), a signature fake, a patch of the seam iw.ask, a judge that reads nothing patched) and an unresolvable target is listed as unresolved

over the real tree, the pre-fix sources at d41cdc76c of corrosion's tooth, test_transitions and test_entry_gate_jurisdiction are reported; the 0c2c draining fake at d41cdc76c is not, and six asker-side proof files are silent

decisions.text: D1: unseen_patches.py reads patch sites, ask-capable calls (INSPECT_JUDGES by ast, the spread handled; transitions' wire-reaching functions by its own ast call graph; one level of proof-local helper) and the answer-side reach through import_sieve.reaches.
D2: proof_coverage/__init__.py exports unseen_patches and unseen_patch_proofs; lacks() is not changed.
D3: one proof, one tooth per clause, each calling unseen_patches over a scratch repo, never the build_inspector nest.

out: fixing the flagged proofs (their own tickets)

measured.saw: corrosion tooth 2, 3e08's three _TICKETS proofs and d3248's ROOTS tooth patched names the remote judge reads; each found by hand
unseen_patch_proofs over origin/main plus bd008e7e9084 flags 11 files / 91 findings; 3/3 teeth green on Windows; a report-nothing stub red 3/3, a report-everything stub red on teeth 2 and 3
measured.how: akiendell_cc_0 on akiendell, branch patch-tooth @cacb03bdf, relayed by message
